department: Faculty of Physics (Fakultät für Physik), Dekanat

deadline.value: The physics page gives no application deadline; you contact a supervisor, then apply to the Dekanat.

gre_subject.value: Applicants whose degree was earned outside the EU must submit a GRE Subject Test result in Physics or Mathematics.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Subject Test in Physik oder Mathematik vorlegen

supervisor.value: You must get a supervisor's written commitment (Betreuungszusage) before the faculty accepts your doctoral application.

funding.value: The physics page does not say how doctoral students are funded.

entry_route.value: Admission is by a 5-year master's with grade good or better, or by a 3-year bachelor's with grade very good, which also needs a mentor.
entry_route.quote: Zulassung zur Promotion ist ein 5...Bachelor-Abschluss mit der Note

notes: The faculty states that doctorates are possible in Astronomie, Meteorologie und Physik, so astronomy and atmospheric science are listed as also_fields. The department page applies the GRE Subject rule to non-EU degrees only; it names no deadline or funding. The English-medium and English-test rules are not on the physics pages, so the university record applies.
